messages:
Priya Nair: Hey y'all — got my Surface Laptop and Autopilot OOBE is failing with a "pre-provisioning failed" error and then asks for a BitLocker recovery key. I'm still in setup and can't sign in. Anyone seen this? macOS fans: this one's Windows :)
IT Support: Hi Priya — welcome! Can you share the serial (or S/N in the sticker) and whether you used the office WiFi or a USB-Ethernet dongle?
Priya Nair: Serial: 0123456789ABC. I used Office-WiFi. No ethernet.
device-bot: [device-lookup] Model: Surface Laptop 5; Autopilot: registered; Intune record: provisioning_failed; TPM status: initialized; BitLocker protector: not yet escrowed
IT Support: Sounds like BitLocker kicked in mid-OOBE. Sometimes the network/proxy interrupts Autopilot so Windows falls back into local recovery. Two options: 1) finish OOBE on a network without captive portal (phone hotspot) so Autopilot reaches Intune and escrow the recovery key, or 2) we can send a temporary autopilot policy to disable encrypt-on-first-signin then reprovision.
Priya Nair: I can hotspot. Before I reboot any commands I should run? I'm stuck at the recovery key prompt so no shell.
Sam: You won't be able to run commands from that screen. Hotspot is easiest. Bring up the wifi chooser on the recovery screen (top-right) -> connect -> back -> Autopilot should retry. If it still asks for a key, message me and we'll escalate to manual recovery.
IT Support: If reconnecting works, Intune will receive the device and you should see a "Device enrolled" state. After that BitLocker will be enforced by policy and the recovery key will be uploaded automatically to Azure AD.
Priya Nair: Switched to phone hotspot, restarted. OOBE progressed past the recovery screen and I can enter my corp email for SSO now.
device-bot: [intune-event] Enrollment: success; device_id: 9f8e7d6c; bitlocker_key_escrow: pending
IT Support: Nice. Wait a minute and then check https://portal.azure.com > Intune > Devices or run this once you can sign in:
```powershell
# run in admin Powershell after login
Get-BitLockerVolume | Select-Object MountPoint, KeyProtector, EncryptionPercentage
(Get-AzureADDevice -SearchString "Priya" ).ObjectId # to verify in AAD
```
Priya Nair: Logged in. Ran Get-BitLockerVolume -> shows OS volume encryption 100% and KeyProtector present. Portal shows recovery key entry (escrowed). All green. :white_check_mark:
people-ops: Welcome Priya!! We'll drop off a docking station and a sticker pack later. If you need admin for any dev tools first week, ping us and IT will grant a short-lived sudo/admin session.
Sam: Marking this as a known issue for Office-WiFi captive portals breaking Autopilot pre-provisioning. Filing a doc with workaround (hotspot or ethernet) and we'll ask infra to whitelist autopilot endpoints.
Priya Nair: Thanks everyone — that fixed it. Appreciate the speedy help! :tada:
